name: Strahnbrad army camp (Arthas's camp)
region: Lordaeron hills on the south road, below the cut over the hill; a huddle of grey roofs (Strahnbrad) where the road crosses a stream at the foot of the slope

sensoryProfile.sight: A whole long slope covered with tents in rows across former pasture, the lanes between them trodden to soup; horses in lines along the hedges, hundreds; banners cracking on poles above the biggest tents, blue and white with the King's gold; Silver Hand knights in heavy plate and white tabards with the silver hand stitched on each, walking horses near the stream; archers on an earth bank above the stream. Across the valley on the eastern hills, thick dark smoke columns leaning together; at the foot of one, a small orange flicker (a roof burning).
sensoryProfile.sound: Officers shouting across a banner pole about a ford; a mule braying on and on; a horn; men shouting; a rider coming hard from the east shouting the prince's name.
sensoryProfile.smell: Mud, wet canvas, horse lines, dung, woodsmoke; dust at head height.
sensoryProfile.touch: Mud ankle-deep and cold; camp mud plastered on Arthas's greaves.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: An army facing east at the smoke while the thing it should fear comes up the road at its back in sacks. Orderly, busy, courteous to strangers, and not looking.

establishedFacts.fact: The Strahnbrad camp sits on the south road in the hills, a day or so before Andorhal by the back way. Arthas's big tent is the command centre; riders go out east and come back east; pickets on the east edge are doubled; on the road side there is one sergeant and a hedge; the archers above the stream have their backs to the road; wagons turn in behind the cook-tents and nobody looks into them.
The eastern hills are burning: raiders 'out of the camps' with axes have burned farms between Strahnbrad and the river. The Garrow farm burned yesterday (the roof still coming down at the audience).
The audience takes place in the open, in the mud, at the hedge-gap on the road side, not in a tent. The party is not turned away; they are offered food and water and decline.
The sergeant on the road side holds the gap with a spear; a boy runs messages up the lanes; Arthas is fetched in a few minutes.

eventsHere.event: Jaina lays the plague case before Arthas; he believes her and chooses the orc war; Sylvanas calls it; Jaina concedes. The party leaves for Andorhal.
